title: Classification Accuracy
prompt:
Evaluate a single-label classifier. Implement `classification_accuracy(y_true, y_pred)` for two sequences of labels.

Return the fraction of matching labels, rounded to four decimal places. Numeric or string labels are compared by equality. Reject empty inputs or unequal lengths; an `assert` is sufficient, and the legacy sentinel `-1` is also accepted.

example.reasoning: Two of three same-position labels match, so accuracy is round(2 / 3, 4).
